name: brand-kit-os-leafpad
description: Brand context, voice enforcement, and Leafpad blog publishing for Claude — powered by Brand Kit OS.
author: Nicolas Thatcher

brand_kit_api_key.title: Brand Kit OS API key
brand_kit_api_key.description: Your Brand Kit OS API key (get one at https://brandkitos.com/settings → API Keys)

publish_mode.title: Default publish mode
publish_mode.description: Default publishing behavior for /publish-pipeline: 'draft' (unpublished, review in Leafpad), 'published' (live immediately), or 'scheduled' (uses leafpad_add_scheduled_posts). Valid values: draft, published, scheduled. Override per run with --draft / --publish / --schedule.
